title: Molecular recognition and potentiometric determination of neostigmine and pyridostigmine by a methylene-bridged naphthotube
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9657-9661
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09021G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jian-Fang Wu, Wen-Jie Chen, Li-Li Wang, Liu-Pan Yang, Yan-Fang Wang, Dehua Liao
The methylene-bridged naphthotube strongly binds neostigmine and pyridostigmine, making it a potential ionophore for their potentiometric determination, promising for pharmaceutical analysis.
